reason: Test-fixture repair only, no product code. Seven Playwright fixture Cores (ui/tests/fixtures/{available_host,butler_administration,butler_inspection,butler_runtime_settings,butler_setup,butler_sources,manual_note_review}_core.py) replaced cli.create_app and called cli.main(); since serve became the supervisor (b833782) it no longer calls cli.create_app, so their journeys got a plain Core without the seeded project or inert adapters. The new ui/tests/fixtures/in_process_core.py serves a fixture's application in-process with the arguments serve passed before the supervisor, and the factories await the store and platform calls #939 made async. Selected: the three real-Core journeys whose fixtures were verified on this exact tree on desktop Chromium (manual-note-review, butler-sources, butler-inspection), and the two tests/v3 suites that import helper names from these fixture modules and pass on main (butler inspection, butler admin settings).
exclusions: Only the assistant-real-desktop profile of each selected area: the change is in the Python fixture, not in layout, and the other seven profiles run the same fixture. Not selected because they were not run to completion on this tree: butler-administration (passed once on a combined tree, 396 s), butler-integration-profiles, butler-setup-controls, butler-core-metadata, nebula-voice and settings-assistant journeys that use butler_runtime_settings_core, butler_setup_core, butler_administration_core or available_host_core. tests/v3/test_butler_setup_controls.py is not selected: 9 of its tests fail on pristine main and the same number fail here (it exercises InertSetupIO, which this change leaves as it is; #1044 repairs that suite). No frontend or native code changed. Journeys were run locally against a production UI build with a Python 3.12 Core, the scratch host-pressure shim and a per-journey user scope; nothing was deployed.
